lines.text: Once upon a time, a little rabbit named Khelu found a shiny pebble by the river. "Where did you come from?" Khelu asked. The pebble only sparkled in the sun. So Khelu carried it home, and showed it to every friend in the meadow. What do you think the pebble was?
A tiny cloud wanted to be a rainbow. So it waited for the sun, and, splash! It painted the whole sky.
A sleepy moon forgot to go home. The stars giggled, and tucked it in behind the hills.
A little seed was scared of the dark soil. Then the rain whispered, "Grow!", and up it popped, saying hello to the sun.
